Finally, the rule must be published in the Federal Register with a mandatory delay of at least 30 to 60 days before the effective date. Given that the remaining time from the present date (September 13, 2026) to the deadline of August 25, 2027, is exactly 346 calendar days, the physical and sequential duration of the required administrative rulemaking steps leaves virtually no schedule buffer. Any standard bureaucratic delays, complex economic data modeling required for a six-figure fee change, or backlogs in OIRA scheduling will exceed the remaining calendar window, making the formal finalization of the rule by August 25, 2027, physically unachievable.
